(Currently Amended) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments, wherein the conduit has an axial length, and wherein the instrument throughput channel extends along the axial length.

(Currently Amended) The system of claim 32 wherein the conduit comprises a first lumen in fluid communication with the first balloon, a second lumen in fluid communication with the second balloon, and a third lumen defining the instrument throughput channel.

(Currently Amended) The system of claim 34 wherein the gastric space filler further comprises a coupling mechanism configured to facilitate engagement with a retrieval device for removal of the gastric space filler from the gastric cavity via the esophagus, wherein the coupling mechanism is a mechanism that engages with the gastric space filler to secure it for retrieval.

(Currently Amended) The system of claim 36 wherein the conduit comprises an inter-balloon section spacing the first balloon apart from the second balloon, and wherein the inter-balloon section has a length of about 10-40 mm.
